They now convert the binary precision to decimal digits before calling evalf, so for example a 53-bit request no longer returns a roughly 179-bit Float. Both candidates describe this correctly, name the same five functions, and use the right header (codegen). A is shorter, and B says a little more clearly that the results carried too much precision.
